title: EGFR fresh Gate3 recovery after scoped-result label failure
scope: One new EGFR fresh attempt from Gate1 through a validated Gate3 decision card; Gate3 is not approved.
precedence: This addendum governs only the post-failure EGFR recovery attempt and does not rewrite or invalidate the append-only records from the base cohort.

change_boundary.observed_failure: The Binder copied the display label full_result instead of the exact /result-*.json value; the guard classified that recoverable argument error as a fatal AgentBoundaryError.
change_boundary.code_change: Render the exact immutable result reference in navigation instructions. A literal full_result label is now handled by the existing bounded unknown-reference repair path, which lists only references already issued to the current role, thread and execution.
change_boundary.authority_change: None. Foreign, stale, tampered and cross-role references remain fatal; no implicit alias is resolved and no scientific content is exposed by repair feedback.
change_boundary.scientific_change: None. Target, Site, Binder, Judge, compiler, validation and Gate policies are unchanged.

execution.goal: Design a VHH nanobody against the human EGFR ectodomain that is intended to inhibit ligand-driven receptor activation.

freshness_contract.project_state: Use a never-before-existing r4 project path, thread, run ID and runtime-state path. Do not copy or resume r2/r3 state.
freshness_contract.tracked_tree: Clean at attempt start except the pre-existing protected untracked audit, which remains byte-untouched.
freshness_contract.failed_attempts: Retain r2 and r3 projects and logs unchanged for audit.
freshness_contract.retry: Any further replacement uses a new attempt identity and is reported separately.

required: current Design proposal and Gate3 decision card exist
compiled design artifacts pass size and SHA verification
no Gate3 response or design approval exists
no Pilot, handoff, generation or StrategyBundle event/path exists

verification.extended_tests: 60 passed; two pre-existing hard-context-threshold assertions remain stale after the earlier 250000-character policy change
